topic: Filtering logic for vendor IDs and locals
summary_markdown: A discussion regarding filtering conditions in data queries. It was noted that a specific condition, `AND (vendor_id!=0 and vendor_id!=22 and vendor_id!=74)`, might incorrectly exclude local vendors. [p1] confirmed that when local content is included, the vendor ID exclusion condition must be disabled.
decisions: When including locals, the vendor ID exclusion filter must be removed.
